mapper.select:
select FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_ABBR shortName from PA_PRD_ISSUE_SCHEDULE
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{param}),'%') or FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{param}),'%'))

select FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FINPROD_NAME finprodName, FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode, VDATE vdate, MDATE mdate, RAISE_STRDATE raiseStrdate, RAISE_ENDDATE raiseEnddate, ISSUE_MODE issueMode, REMARK remark, FINPROD_ID finprodId from PA_PRD_ISSUE_SCHEDULE
and FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{prodId}),'%')
and VDATE >= to_date(#{vdateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and VDATE <= to_date(#{vdateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
select count(1) from PA_PRD_ISSUE_SCHEDULE where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and PROD_REGIST_CODE is not null

select SCHEME_ID id, SCHEME_NAME text from PRD_DECLARE_SCHEME where exists (select 1 from PRD_DECLARE_SCHEME_DOC where PRD_DECLARE_SCHEME.SCHEME_ID = PRD_DECLARE_SCHEME_DOC.SCHEME_ID)
and (SCHEME_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or SCHEME_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
